## Featured Projects
- [Leaf Doctor](https://leaf-doctor-front.vercel.app/): AI-powered plant disease diagnosis platform using React, TypeScript, and AI APIs.
- [Reflecto](https://reflecto.com.sa/): Backend booking, loyalty, and payment system for car detailing in Saudi Arabia built with Node.js, Express, and MySQL.
- [EnglishTaxo](https://englishtaxo.com/): Full-stack educational institute management platform built with React, Node.js, Express, and MySQL.
- [Islamic Platform](https://eslamic-jade.vercel.app/): Comprehensive Islamic web platform featuring Quran, audio recitations, and tafsir.
- [Ramadan Challenge](https://ramadan-site-six.vercel.app/): Ramadan daily tracker and prayer challenge application.
- [Masertak](https://masertak.vercel.app/): Educational training and international scholarship guide platform.
- [Evolve Nova](https://evolve-nova.vercel.app/): Modern company website for corporate training and development.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, JWT Authentication, Payment Gateways
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase
